name: MacPherson
summary: Central-east HDB and light-industrial fringe with CCL/DTL access — practical rents beside Paya Lebar offices without paying Dakota condo premiums.
body: MacPherson is the shortlist when someone wants Circle / Downtown Line adjacency and heartland errands without East Coast or River Valley pricing. Mature HDB blocks, walk-up pockets, and newer inserts sit beside workshops and business parks toward the Paya Lebar / Tai Seng belt. Expats land here for commute math into Paya Lebar Quarter and the CBD via CCL/DTL hops, plus ActiveSG / community sport options in the wider Kallang–Geylang catchment. Walk the block at rush hour: feeder buses, industrial traffic, and estate variance matter more than brochure copy. Compare with Tai Seng when you want to live closer to the industrial-MRT edge, Paya Lebar when mall and office gravity dominate, and Potong Pasir when you want a quieter NELine-adjacent feel further in.
bestFor: Paya Lebar / CBD hoppers on CCL or DTL
heartland rents without far-east commute length
watchOuts: Block-level variance beside workshops and yards
Peak feeder and industrial traffic noise
Thinner expat lobby defaults than River Valley
housingMix: Mature HDB and walk-ups with selective condo / executive inserts toward Paya Lebar.
commuteNotes: Circle and Downtown Line access via MacPherson; model a rainy Tuesday door-to-desk into PLQ or Raffles Place.
